issues.location: opening claim about finite model property and decidability
issues.finding: The prose presents finite model property as enough to decide systems given by schemas. The two-search argument also requires effective proof enumeration and effective enumeration of relevant finite countermodels; the argument as written establishes the result for S5.
issues.proposed_resolution: Qualify the target claim to effectively axiomatized systems with effectively enumerable relevant finite countermodels, stating that finite model property can yield decidability.

issues.location: second parallel search in the S5 decidability proof
issues.finding: The source says to enumerate all finite models. A theorem of S5 can fail in an arbitrary finite non-S5 model, so this would produce a false nonderivability answer. The proof's preceding S5 argument supplies finite universal countermodels.
issues.proposed_resolution: Enumerate finite universal models in the target's second search.
